title: Muse: Text-To-Image Generation via Masked Generative Transformers
layout_note: Three rows. Top row: a quoted text prompt, a Text Encoder box and the Text Embedding strip. Middle row (base stage): 256x256 photo, VQ Tokenizer, Mask, 4x4 Masked Tokens grid, Base Transformer, 4x4 Reconstructed Tokens grid. Bottom row (super-res stage) repeats the same sequence with a larger 512x512 photo and 8x8 grids into a SuperRes Transformer. The embedding's output line splits: one branch drops with a rounded elbow into the top of the Base Transformer, the other runs right to the far column and drops down into the top of the SuperRes Transformer; a dashed line from the base row's reconstructed tokens joins that same vertical drop.
grouping: No background panels, frames or brackets: the three rows are separated only by white space and each row reads as one left-to-right chain. Each stage's boxes get their own pale tint family (base row: peach tokenizer, pale-blue transformer; super-res row: pale-green tokenizer, lavender transformer), while the text encoder is neutral grey. Tensor names sit above each token grid in bold sans, and the two losses sit below the output grids in a monospace font.
shapes_depth: Flat throughout, no shadows or 3-D. Modules are rounded rectangles with a pale fill and a thin outline in a darker shade of the same hue; names in regular sans, centred. Mask is a narrow, tall white rectangle with a black outline and the word rotated 90 degrees. Tokens are flat square grids (4x4 in the base row, 8x8 in the super-res row) of grey (masked) and graded blue cells; the text embedding is a horizontal strip of six green squares in two shades. Inputs are real photographs with their resolution written beneath, the super-res photo drawn larger. Arrows are thick black straight lines with solid heads; the conditioning lines turn with rounded elbows, and short down-arrows point from the output grids to the loss labels.
proposed_highlight: No legend or 'ours' marker: the two transformers are the only boxes that receive the text-conditioning arrows from above, and they carry the strongest outline colours (bright blue for Base Transformer, purple for SuperRes Transformer), so the eye lands on them as the points where the rows converge.
lesson: Draw a two-resolution cascade as two rows with the same image-tokenizer-mask-grid-transformer-grid sequence, enlarging the input photo and the token grid in the lower row to show the higher resolution, and bring the shared condition down from a top row as elbow arrows into each row's transformer.
notes: Venue unverified: refs.json records ICML from memory (not checked), so the venue is written as arXiv; year = arXiv preprint year (2301.00704). The token grids and the text-embedding strip are raster images in the PDF and were recorded by refs crop as embedded images together with the two photographs, so kb measure leaves their greys, blues and greens out of the palette and counts them in photo_share.

measured.source: computed: paperfig kb measure (non-white pixels of a <= 800 px thumbnail, white = min(R,G,B) >= 245, minus the embedded images recorded by `refs crop` (images_px; their share is photo_share, null without a record); chromatic (RGB spread > 20) and neutral pixels clustered separately by PIL median-cut + k-means (k=8 / 3); clusters within dE00 4 merged; kept if >= 0.02 of chromatic pixels / neutral ones if >= 0.03 of all non-white pixels; share = fraction of the non-photo non-white pixels)

core.what: two parallel image tracks - a 256x256 base track and a 512x512 super-resolution track below it - each VQ Tokenizer, Mask, masked token grid, Transformer, reconstructed grid, with one text-embedding line from the top feeding both transformers

relations.form: the base track (middle row) and super-resolution track (bottom row) run left to right in the same order with the same glyphs; a dashed line from the base reconstructed tokens joins the line down into the SuperRes Transformer

the text prompt 'A cat looking at a dog' goes through a Text Encoder to a row of green embedding cells on top, whose line branches down into the Base Transformer and, along the right, into the SuperRes Transformer

tokens are drawn as small blue grids with grey masked cells (4 x 4 for the base, 8 x 8 for high-res), the masked grid before each transformer and the fully filled grid after it, with 'Cross Entropy Loss' under each reconstructed grid

channels.colour: box fill/border = module (orange and green tokenizers, blue base, purple SuperRes); blue cells = tokens, grey cells = masked; green cells = text embedding
channels.shape: photos = inputs; cell grids = token maps; rounded boxes = modules; tall narrow box = mask operation
channels.line: solid arrows = data flow; dashed line = the base output conditioning the super-resolution stage

quality.strengths: the masked-to-filled change is drawn as data: the same grid before and after each transformer, grey cells filled in; the two resolution tracks are aligned rows with token grids sized by resolution; real photos labelled with their sizes
quality.weaknesses: the dashed base-output line merges into the text-embedding line before reaching SuperRes, so the two conditions arrive as one wire; each module has its own pastel colour with no shared meaning, so the two VQ Tokenizers look like different kinds of module; the text-to-SuperRes line takes a long path down the right side

insights.structure: Three horizontal tracks: text prompt and text encoder on top, a 256x256 base track in the middle and a 512x512 super-resolution track at the bottom, each image track being VQ Tokenizer, Mask, token grid, Transformer, reconstructed grid.
insights.data: Inputs are real dog-and-cat photos labelled with resolution, the text prompt is quoted in italics, the text embedding is a row of green cells, and tokens are small blue/grey grids where grey cells are masked.
insights.emphasis: Each module box has its own pastel fill and border (orange and green tokenizers, blue base, purple SuperRes transformer), and the two token grids before and after each transformer make the masked-to-filled change visible.
insights.flow: Left to right in each track; the text embedding arrow drops into both transformers, and a dashed line carries base reconstructed tokens down into the SuperRes transformer.

arrangement.units: unboxed horizontal tracks of rounded coloured module boxes alternating with token grids
arrangement.inputs_as: real photos at two resolutions and a quoted text prompt
arrangement.shared: one text embedding feeds both transformers
